question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fathomable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Incoherent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fathomable"** means something that can be understood or comprehended. (समझने योग्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The mystery of the missing artifact was finally fathomable after the detective's explanation.
 
 
 
• **"Incoherent" **refers to something that is unclear and difficult to understand; lacking logical connection. (असंगत)
 
 
• **Example: **His speech was so incoherent that no one could follow his argument.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'fathomable' **is **'incoherent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Incoherent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inauspicious **(अशुभ): Not conducive to success; unpromising.

 
 
• **Example:** They chose to delay the event due to an inauspicious weather forecast.
 
 
 
• **Incite **(उकसाना): To stir up violent or unlawful behavior.
 
 
• **Example: **His speech was intended to incite the crowd to riot.
 
 
 
• **Inartistic** (कलाहीन): Lacking artistic qualities or sense.
 
 
• **Example:** The inartistic design of the building made it look dull and unappealing.
